cardOverview.overviewText: A defense-focused card from Bank of Baroda designed for armed forces, offering fee waivers, insurance benefits, and rewards on essential spends like fuel and groceries.

mileStoneItems.benefits: 500 bonus reward points on spends of Rs. 5000 or more within 60 days of card issuance.Get a complimentary subscription to the Disney+ Hotstar Super Plan for 3 months.
